fomod.Name: OStim Together
fomod.Author: OStim Together project
fomod.Description: Synchronizes OStim Standalone scenes through Skyrim Together Reborn. Uses one unified remote scene-anchor pipeline for physical furniture, free-standing and wall scenes, with synchronized participant alignment, scene controls and NPC undressing. v0.34.0 keeps the validated PPA synchronization and makes remote OCum RaceMenu state owner-authoritative: complete CumOverlays snapshots are assembled before application, locally simulated/stale CumOverlays slots on the STR proxy are cleared when they are absent from the owner's snapshot, and the validated proxy overlay repair pipeline is then replayed. This prevents mirrored OStim/OCum from accumulating duplicate cum-overlay slots, including on physical furniture.
